findings.title: isAccessTokenId matcher uses wrong substring indices and inverted equality check
findings.body:
In `AssertEvents.isAccessTokenId`, the check `if (items[0].substring(3, 5).equals(expectedGrantShortcut)) return false;` has two bugs:

1. The encoded context prefix is 6 characters long (`<2-char sessionType><2-char tokenType><2-char grantType>`, see `DefaultTokenContextEncoderProvider.java` lines 78-81 where `gtShortcut = encodedContext.substring(4, 6)`). Using `substring(3, 5)` extracts the second character of `tokenType` and the first character of `grantType` (e.g. `"ta"` for `"onrtac"`) instead of the grant shortcut at indices 4..6.
2. The condition is inverted: it returns `false` when the substring equals `expectedGrantShortcut` instead of when it does `!equals(...)`. Because `substring(3, 5)` almost never matches a valid grant shortcut, the matcher currently passes even when the grant shortcut in the token ID is completely wrong.

It should check `if (items[0].length() != 6 || !items[0].substring(4, 6).equals(expectedGrantShortcut)) return false;`.

findings.title: Constructor checks grantType for null twice instead of checking rawTokenId
findings.body: In the `AccessTokenContext` constructor, line 73 calls `Objects.requireNonNull(grantType, "Null rawTokenId not allowed");` instead of `Objects.requireNonNull(rawTokenId, "Null rawTokenId not allowed");`. As a result, a null `rawTokenId` is not rejected at construction time.

findings.title: Javadoc says 3-letter shortcut, but implementation requires exactly 2 characters
findings.body: The Javadoc on `OAuth2GrantTypeFactory.getShortcut()` states `@return usually like 3-letters shortcut of specific grants`, whereas `DefaultTokenContextEncoderProvider` requires the full encoded prefix to be 6 characters (2 characters per part, with `encodedContext.substring(4, 6)` for the grant shortcut) and all implementations return 2-character strings. A custom `OAuth2GrantTypeFactory` author following the Javadoc and returning a 3-letter shortcut would cause `getTokenContextFromTokenId` to fail with `IllegalArgumentException: Expected length of 6`.
